record.question: Beta blokers benefit performance by:
options: increasing heart and respiratory rates and suppressing the symptoms of fatigue.
having a painkilling and sedating effect.
releasing hormones promoting growth, healing and body repair.
record.explanation: The PDF (Coach Grade-III Technical Paper-II, April 2019, Q24) asks how beta blockers benefit performance. Beta blockers block the adrenaline (beta-adrenergic) receptors, so the option describing prevention of adrenaline's effects is the correct one, even though the printed wording is slightly garbled.
